cuts.ofreeRecent: the paved square before a city gate tower — standing; a grand museum hall with marble statues at night — holds a freshly printed instant photo up to the light; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — rests a red oil-paper umbrella open on her shoulder; a quiet city tram-stop platform at dawn — she is delightedly taking a first bite from a very large steamed breakfast bun before the tram arrives; a small outdoor carnival rehearsal yard with striped fabric pavilions — she is trying the padded seat of a miniature fairground ride; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — kneeling on the ground; a sunny enclosed veranda with drying racks overhead — blow-dries her hair with a hair dryer; her private chamber in a Han-era residence — kneeling on the ground; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — kneeling on one knee; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; the grand staircase of an old castle — holds a wooden practice sword point-down at her side
